run_generate_pddl: run generate_pddl.py to produce grammar-constrained PDDL command sequences using a causal language model
run_generate_pddl_blocks: run generate_pddl.py with --pddl-type blocks to generate blocks world action sequences
run_generate_pddl_depot: run generate_pddl.py with --pddl-type depot to generate depot logistics action sequences
run_generate_pddl_satellite: run generate_pddl.py with --pddl-type satellite to generate satellite instrument action sequences
run_generate_pddl_custom_model: run generate_pddl.py with --model-id to use a custom language model for PDDL generation
